---
title: "Cheat sheet"
description: "Git in RStudio, Positron and the terminal."
---

| Task | RStudio | Positron | Terminal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Clone a repository | *File → New Project → Version Control → Git* | *File → New Folder from Git...* | `git clone URL` |
| See which branch you're on | Branch menu, top right of the Git pane | Status bar, bottom left | `git branch --show-current` |
| Create a branch | Git pane → **New Branch** | Status bar → **Create new branch...** | `git switch -c name` |
| Switch branch | Git pane branch menu | Status bar branch menu | `git switch name` |
| See what changed | Git pane → **Diff** | Source Control → click the file | `git status`, `git diff` |
| Stage a file | Tick **Staged** | **+** next to the file | `git add file` |
| Unstage a file | Untick **Staged** | **−** next to the file | `git restore --staged file` |
| Commit | **Commit** → message → **Commit** | Message box → **Commit** | `git commit -m "message"` |
| Push a new branch | **Push** | **Publish Branch** | `git push -u origin name` |
| Push / pull | **Push** / **Pull** arrows | **Sync Changes** | `git push`, `git pull` |
| Discard edits to a file | Right-click → **Revert...** | **Discard Changes** | `git restore file` |
| Fix the last commit (not pushed) | Tick **Amend previous commit** | **...** → **Commit** → **Commit (Amend)** | `git commit --amend` |
| Undo a pushed commit | Terminal | Terminal | `git revert <id>` |
| History | **History** (clock icon) | Source Control Graph | `git log --oneline` |
| Stop tracking a file | Terminal | Terminal | `git rm --cached file` |

## Conflict markers

```
<<<<<<< HEAD
your version
=======
their version
>>>>>>> other-branch
```

Edit to the text you want, delete all three marker lines, then stage and commit.

## Branch names

`yourname/short-description`, lowercase, hyphens instead of spaces: `alex/fix-phn-labels`.
